In detail

Grouped with Dębniki and Podgórze in the 2024 police district breakdown (235 property thefts, 17 vehicle thefts, 20 burglaries, 10 robberies, 36 bodily injuries, 8 fights across the three combined — a moderate, mid-table result). The 2020 Otodom survey placed the broader Dębniki/Łagiewniki/Borek Fałęcki/Swoszowice evening-safety group at 3.99/5. No incident coverage specific to this individual district (rather than the wider grouping) was found, so this is rated with the caution that comes from thin, grouped-only evidence. Sources checked: Kraków Nasze Miasto (2024 police district data); Otodom District Ranking 2020.
